summary: First full backend test run for Aura/Lumi API. 21/21 tests pass after 1 minor code fix. Coverage: health, auth (register/login/me + edge cases), moods (create/latest/validation), chat (message with emotion tag stripping, history ordering, current_session, voice=true audio), voice (TTS base64, STT round-trip via TTS->STT), daily actions (mood-personalized + completion reflection), social suggestions, events (list, category filter, categories endpoint). Verified all responses exclude MongoDB _id and are prefixed with /api. Emotion tag parsing works (returns one of happy/calm/thoughtful/encouraging/gentle/proud/listening and strips the [tag] from content). Voice pipeline (Whisper STT + OpenAI TTS sage 0.95) works after a small fix to /api/voice/transcribe.
action_items: None blocking. All 21 backend tests green. Backend is ready for frontend integration testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and mixes auth, moods, chat, voice, actions, social, events. Consider splitting into modules (routers/) as it grows beyond 700 lines.
CORS is set to allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=True — browsers will reject this combo; fine for mobile clients but note if a web build is planned.

logger is defined AFTER routes that reference it (logger.exception inside chat/voice handlers). It works at request time because logging.basicConfig runs at import, but stylistically the module-level logger should be declared near the top before routes.

chat/message system prompt still references 'Aura' in transcript labels though the assistant is now 'Lumi' (line ~367 uses "Aura: {content}"). Cosmetic only — Claude still produces Lumi-style replies, but rename for consistency.
voice_transcribe: temp file cleanup is best-effort; consider using a context manager. Also file extension detection ignores the mimetype header — acceptable for now.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py  (fixed STT: pass Path(tmp.name) instead of str path to OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe — openai SDK requires bytes/IOBase/PathLike/tuple)
seed_data_creation: Created test user test@aura.dev/testpass123 (if not already present), one 'good' mood, a couple of chat messages, and one action completion for today. Also creates one ephemeral TEST_user_<ts>@aura.dev per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully green. Public base URL: https://mindful-buddy-14.preview.emergentagent.com (from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Note: frontend .env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo public runtime var), not EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Test user test@aura.dev/testpass123 is guaranteed to exist. STT endpoint now works after fix; TTS returns audio_base64 ~30–70KB for short strings. Chat is LLM-backed (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations) so allow up to 90s timeouts; voice=true adds another few seconds for TTS.
rca_of_issue: Bug fixed in this run: /api/voice/transcribe returned 500. Root cause: server.py passed `file=tmp.name` (a str path) to emergentintegrations OpenAISpeechToText.transcribe, which forwards to litellm/openai. The OpenAI Python SDK's audio.transcriptions endpoint requires bytes / io.IOBase / PathLike / tuple and explicitly rejects str. Fix: wrap with pathlib.Path(tmp.name) so a PathLike is passed. Verified end-to-end with a TTS->STT round-trip test that now returns non-empty text.
